description: This file contains a benchmark class 'ArrayDeserializeBenchmark' that compares the performance of deserialization of array types across different serializers, including Orleans, MessagePack, Protobuf, and System.Text.Json. It sets up sample data, serializes it with various serializers, and provides benchmark methods for deserialization.
